text.brief: On May 4, 1919, about three thousand students marched from their campuses to Tiananmen to protest the award of Shandong to Japan at Paris.
text.record: Woodrow Wilson agreed at the end of April 1919 to let Japan keep the German rights in Shandong. The Republic of China's delegates refused to sign the Treaty of Versailles that June. Soviet Russia's Karakhan Manifesto of July 1919 offered to give up Tsarist privileges in China, and the offer reached Chinese readers in March 1920.
text.reading: Wilson's principles raised a hope, his bargain broke it, and the Leninist offer arrived in the gap it left. The Party dates its own origins to the May Fourth Movement, a birth in the disappointment the defenders caused.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The defenders proclaimed self-determination and then traded a Chinese province to hold a coalition together.
text.fix: Apply stated principles evenly or say plainly where they stop, because an adversary recruits in the gap between the two.
